sources.snippet: The AI-Powered Hand Gesture Controlled Robot uses Python, OpenCV, and MediaPipe to detect hand gestures via a webcam, translating them into commands for an ESP32-controlled robot. Integrating AI, IoT, and embedded systems, it enables contactless control for automation and assistive tech, providing hands-on experience in AI-driven robotics. - iamvny/AI-Powered-Hand-Gesture-Controlled-Robot
